front: Who is the Allfather and ruler of Asgard?
back: Odin — the one-eyed god of wisdom, war, death, and poetry

front: What is the name of the great tree that connects the nine worlds?
back: Yggdrasil — the World Tree, an immense ash tree

front: What are the nine worlds in Norse cosmology?
back: Asgard, Midgard, Jotunheim, Vanaheim, Alfheim, Svartalfheim, Niflheim, Muspelheim, and Helheim

front: What sacrifice did Odin make to gain wisdom?
back: He hung himself on Yggdrasil for nine days and nights, pierced by his own spear, to learn the runes

front: Why does Odin have only one eye?
back: He sacrificed it at Mimir's Well in exchange for a drink that granted cosmic wisdom
